_comment: Which of mxm-shimmer's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
Mix fills the existing fx.reverb role: it is how much reverb is in what you hear.
The seven dedicated roles occupy page 12 and leave its eighth slot free deliberately.
Diffusion, Mod Rate, Mod Depth, Low Cut, High Cut and Pre-delay are stored space-shaping
controls rather than the controls reached for while the effect plays; they remain automatable
and on the panel. Mod Rate and Mod Depth join that group for the same reason, even though Mod
Depth measurably shortens the tail: it is set once for a space, not played.
